# RunComfy Image to Video

💳 Paid API required — Curated by Skill Harbor — a focused Pro Pack that animates any still image on RunComfy: the agent routes your intent to the right image-to-video model — HappyHorse 1.0 I2V (arena #1, native audio, identity preservation) for general animation, Wan 2.7 with `audio_url` for custom-voiceover lip-sync, or Seedance 2.0 Pro for multi-modal animation from image + reference video + reference audio — with each model's documented prompting patterns so you get sharper output without burning iterations on the wrong model. By @genmedia-labs, listed here with credit to its creator. Requires the `runcomfy` CLI and a RunComfy account with paid generation credits.
